newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Aluminum Association ups recycling target.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Aluminum Association ups recycling target.

text.p: U.S. Aluminum Association said it has endorsed a 75 percent recycling rate goal for used aluminum beverage cans, an advance on the current rate of 63.5 percent of the 99 billion cans produced annually.
The association gave no date when it hoped to reach its goal.
In 1996, the industry paid out approximately $1.08 billion to recyclers for their used aluminum beverage cans, the association said in a statement.
The recycling challenge was made to the industry in May by Brian Sturgell of Alcan during his remarks at the association's international conference, Alumitech.
"We look forward to the day in the not too distant future when we will announce a 75 percent recycling rate for used aluminum beverage cans," Aluminum Association president David Parker said.
